hr-1-119.title: Estimated Budgetary Effects of Public Law 119-21, to Provide for Reconciliation Pursuant to Title II of H. Con. Res. 14, Relative to CBO's January 2025 Baseline
hr-1-119.source_note: CBO publication 61570 (21 July 2025): P.L. 119-21 as enacted 4 July 2025 increases the unified deficit by $3.4 trillion over FY2025-2034 ($1.1T less direct spending, $4.5T less revenue). Publications 61560/61564/61571 are pre-enactment or companion figures, not the as-enacted estimate.

no_cbo_score.hconres-14-119: Budget resolutions are concurrent resolutions: they are not law and CBO does not publish a cost estimate for them (CRS R48532). The +$85B figure previously shown was CBO publication 61838, a P.L. 119-21 follow-up whose truncated title cites Title II of H. Con. Res. 14. Publication 61837 (-$886.8B) is the same mis-map. Both are left unassigned so they cannot outrank publication 61570 on H.R. 1.

hconres-14-119.latest_action: House agreed to the Senate amendment (FY2025 budget resolution adopted).
hconres-14-119.source_note: CRS R48532: Senate agreed 5 April 2025 (51-48); House concurred 10 April 2025 (216-214). congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-concurrent-resolution/14.
